scripts.build: tsc && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .ssg-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.check:visual: playwright test tests/homepage-regression.spec.ts tests/homepage-background-video.spec.ts tests/header-buttons.spec.ts tests/whatsapp-connect.spec.ts tests/legal-pages.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:meta-signed-request: rm -rf .tmp-test-build && tsc server/meta/facebook/signed-request.ts server/meta/facebook/data-deletion-status-token.ts server/meta/config.ts --outDir .tmp-test-build --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler && node scripts/test-meta-signed-request.mjs; status=$?; rm -rf .tmp-test-build; exit $status
scripts.test:meta-embedded-signup: rm -rf .tmp-test-build && tsc src/utils/metaEmbeddedSignup.ts --outDir .tmp-test-build --module esnext --target es2022 --moduleResolution bundler && node scripts/test-meta-embedded-signup.mjs; status=$?; rm -rf .tmp-test-build; exit $status
scripts.perf:test: npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:cls && npm run check:scroll-load && npm run check:scroll-performance
scripts.seo:test: npm run build && npm run check:seo
